prompt: Subject: Gazing from the train window. Main Subject: 3:4 vertical composition. A young woman sitting shallowly on a seat inside an old train car, captured with a focus on her upper body, positioned slightly to the right of the center. Her body from the top of her head to below the chest is largely included, occupying about 70% of the frame as the main subject. Surrounded by train windows, wooden panels, and dark blue seats, a quiet atmosphere of being mid-journey prevails. Person/Expression: A woman in her 20s. Smooth skin with a bright ivory-beige tone and a hint of healthy pink. Soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones, preserving natural skin texture rather than excessive retouching. Sophisticated and delicate doll-like Japanese-style makeup. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long slender lashes, natural eye bags (aegyo-sal), soft light brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lip gloss. Clear, small catchlights in the eyes. Her expression is quiet and soft, with a slightly relaxed mouth, looking directly into the camera. Her head is slightly tilted, exuding a calm presence. Clothing/Pose: A white ribbed halter neck top. Deep V-neck design that naturally creates soft volume. A clean silhouette that follows the body lines, beautifully showcasing the shoulders and collarbones. Arms are down naturally, body slightly angled toward the seat while only the face is turned toward the camera. Slender and mature appearance, avoiding unnatural exaggeration. Small pearl earrings. Background/Lighting: Scene is a retro train passenger cabin. Visible wood-grain walls, old luggage racks, dark blue leather seats, and framed windows. The view outside the window is bright and slightly overexposed, with distant greenery softly blurred. Main light source is natural light coming through the window on the right. Soft white light from a slightly high position gently hits the hair surface, cheeks, shoulders, and chest. The left side retains moderate shadows, with dark areas slightly lifted by reflected light from opposite windows or the interior. Warm brown wood interior and deep navy seats complement the skin and white clothing. Composition/Camera: Vertical portrait photograph. Camera is at a natural close distance, slightly above eye level. Using a medium-telephoto focal length equivalent to 50mm-85mm, the subject is sharply focused while the background has soft bokeh. Composition guides the viewer's gaze toward the face and chest. A small portion of the ceiling is left above the head, with window light on the right and seats in the back left creating depth. Emphasizes a sophisticated photoshoot feel like a magazine gravure, rather than a snapshot. Texture/Style: High-quality photorealistic photo. Captures the airy feel of a natural light portrait, delicate skin texture, soft gradations, individual hair strands, fine highlights, and subtle sheen. Hair color is light milk-tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layered cut along the face, medium-long length reaching below the shoulders. Ends are loosely curled inward, with an airy feel, natural clumps, and a few stray hairs. The overall finish has high artistic quality, combining transparency with the warmth and nostalgia of a wooden train interior. Negative: Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, messy hair, asymmetrical eyes, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, gibberish text, logos, watermarks, broken background, distorted clothing shape.

promptZh: 主体：从列车窗边凝视。主要主体：3:4 竖构图。一位年轻女性浅坐在老式列车车厢的座位上，画面聚焦于上半身，位于画面中心偏右位置。从头顶到胸部以下的身躯占据了约 70% 的画面，作为主要主体。周围是列车车窗、木质镶板和深蓝色座椅，营造出一种旅途中的静谧氛围。人物/表情：20 多岁的女性。皮肤光滑，呈现明亮的象牙米色调，透着一丝健康的粉色。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和锁骨处有柔和的高光，保留了自然的皮肤纹理，而非过度修图。精致细腻的日系娃娃妆容。淡玫瑰粉色腮红，香槟米色与粉棕色眼影，细长的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的浅棕色眉毛，以及清透的粉米色唇彩。眼睛里有清晰的小型眼神光。表情安静柔和，嘴唇微张，直视镜头。头部微微倾斜，散发出沉稳的气质。服装/姿势：白色罗纹挂脖上衣。深 V 领设计自然地营造出柔和的丰盈感。贴合身体线条的简洁轮廓，完美展现了肩膀和锁骨。双臂自然下垂，身体微微转向座位，只有脸部朝向镜头。外形纤细成熟，避免不自然的夸张。佩戴小巧的珍珠耳环。背景/光影：场景为复古列车客舱。可见木纹墙壁、老式行李架、深蓝色皮质座椅和边框窗户。窗外景色明亮且略微过曝，远处的绿植柔和虚化。主要光源是来自右侧窗户的自然光。来自稍高位置的柔和白光轻柔地洒在发丝、脸颊、肩膀和胸部。左侧保留了适度的阴影，暗部由对面窗户或室内反射的光线轻微提亮。温暖的棕色木质内饰与深海军蓝座椅与皮肤和白色服装相得益彰。构图/相机：竖构图人像摄影。相机处于自然的近距离，略高于视线水平。使用相当于 50mm-85mm 的中长焦焦距，主体对焦清晰，背景呈现柔和的虚化效果。构图引导观众的视线聚焦于脸部和胸部。头顶留有少量空间，右侧的窗光与左后方的座椅营造出空间深度。强调杂志写真般的高级摄影感，而非随手抓拍。质感/风格：高质量写实照片。捕捉自然光人像的空气感、细腻的皮肤纹理、柔和的渐变、单根发丝、精致的高光和微妙的光泽。发色为浅奶茶灰棕色。薄透的空气刘海，脸部周围有层次感的剪裁，中长发长度及肩。发尾向内自然卷曲，具有空气感、自然的束感和几缕碎发。整体呈现出极高的艺术品质，将透明感与木质列车内饰的温暖怀旧感完美融合。负面提示词：不自然的脸部、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、凌乱的头发、不对称的眼睛、透视错误、光影不一致、乱码文字、Logo、水印、背景破损、服装形状扭曲。
